slug: 2025-09-17 Mali rolls out new digital tools to modernize public administration

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that on 16 September 2025 the Prime Minister attended the presentation of OpenClinic for the health ministry, a tool that centralises patient records (clinical, financial, pharmaceutical, statistical) and is to be linked to the NINA identification system and the AMO health insurance; no number of facilities is given.
Ecofin Agency reports that OpenClinic was presented on 16 September 2025 as the Health ministry's solution among tools created by local companies for three ministries.
